title: Operations and Reporting Coordinator
description:
Operations and Reporting Coordinator

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Operations Lead.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll keep the back end of our business right: the numbers we d
 on, the products we list, and every order after the customer clicks Buy. You'll prepare our daily sales and ads reports, be our warehouse's main contact, answer our customers, and keep our listings and catalogs accurate on every channel. You'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations, and take vendor follow-up and day-to-day execution off her plate.



This role is half care and half precision. You need to be warm with a customer and politely persistent with a vendor, and you need to refuse to upload, send or pay anything when a number doesn't match its source. The most valuable thing you do is catch the mistake before it goes live.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag anything that doesn't add up.

• Orders and the warehouse: keep orders moving across our store, Amazon and retail partners, be our warehouse's main contact, check the returns, files and invoices it sends us, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims, and look after our product reviews.

• Inventory and listings: keep stock files, product listings, our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs and approved promotions accurate on every channel, checked against our master sheet.

• Production support: get our weekly production meeting ready, and prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs.

• Returns and tickets: reconcile returns and refunds, and follow every open support ticket until it's fixed.

• Systems and SOPs: write down every step you own, keep our trackers current, help set up new sales channels, and run the automations we approve.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• You can trace every number. Ask where a figure came from and you can show the source. You're comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• 2+ years reconciling or reporting operational data: inventory, orders and invoices, e-commerce reporting, or marketplace operations.

• Hands-on e-commerce listing experience: Amazon flat files, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• Customer care for an online brand: order questions, refunds, returns and warranty claims, written warmly and clearly.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• A builder: when something was never written down, you write it down and make it the standard.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, retailer vendor portals, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a warehouse.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every listing and catalog matches our master sheet.

• Every open vendor issue and support ticket has a next step.

• Every recurring step is written down.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.

title: Anime Compositor & Video Editor (After Effects)
description:
# Anime Compositor & Video Editor (After Effects) – $100/Project



**Job Type:** Freelance / Multiple Projects  

**Budget:** $100 USD per project  

**Software:** Adobe After Effects (Required), Clip Studio Paint (Plus)



## Job Description



Lamb Light Studio is an independent studio producing a Christian action anime series called **Stand Firm: A Light in the Shadows**.



We're looking for a talented **2D Anime Compositor & Video Editor** who specializes in Adobe After Effects to help bring our animation to life!



This is a **multi-project freelance opportunity**, with the potential for ongoing work.



Our animation team creates the character animation, backgrounds, and other visual assets. Your job will be to take these clips and transform them into polished, cinematic anime scenes through compositing, lighting, visual effects, and editing.



We are especially interested in artists who understand **anime-style compositing and action sequences**.



## Project References



**Official Anime Trailer (230K+ Views)**  





**Recent Project Upload**  





These videos demonstrate our anime's visual style and overall direction.



## Responsibilities



- Composite individual 2D anime clips using Adobe After Effects

- Combine character animation, backgrounds, and effects into finished scenes

- Add cinematic lighting, shadows, glows, and atmospheric effects

- Create impact frames, motion blur, camera shakes, and speed effects

- Enhance sword fights and action sequences with visual effects

- Apply color correction and grading for visual consistency

- Add camera movements, depth, and cinematic presentation

- Edit animation clips into trailers and promotional videos when needed

- Synchronize footage with dialogue, music, and sound effects

- Deliver organized, editable project files and final rendered clips



**You will not be responsible for drawing or animating entire scenes from scratch.**



We already have animators working on the project. Your focus will be compositing and editing their work.



## Requirements



- Strong proficiency in **Adobe After Effects**

- Experience with 2D anime compositing

- Strong video editing skills

- Understanding of lighting, color grading, and visual effects

- Ability to work with layered animation assets

- Experience enhancing anime action and fight scenes

- Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines

- Comfortable working with Christian themes



**Bonus Skills**



- Clip Studio Paint experience

- Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Experience with anime production pipelines

- Knowledge of anime-style effects and cinematic action editing

- Experience working with frame-by-frame 2D animation



## Compensation & Work Structure



**Starting budget: $100 USD per project.**



Projects may involve compositing individual animation clips, polishing multiple short scenes, or editing promotional material.



The exact workload, deliverables, deadlines, and compensation will be agreed upon before each assignment.



This is not a one-time position. We're looking for someone interested in working with our studio across multiple projects.



As our production grows, there may be opportunities for additional assignments and larger projects.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. **Portfolio:** Show us your best anime compositing or editing work.

2. **Before-and-after examples:** If possible, show clips before and after your compositing work.

3. **Software:** How experienced are you with Adobe After Effects? Do you also use Clip Studio Paint?

4. **Anime experience:** Have you worked on anime productions, fight scenes, or AMVs?

5. **Availability:** How many hours per week can you commit?

6. **Turnaround:** How long would it take you to composite a 10–20 second anime action clip?

7. **Project files:** Can you provide organized, editable After Effects files?



## Important



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply add transitions or edit existing anime clips together.



**We want someone who understands how to make 2D animation look cinematic through professional compositing.**



Reliability, communication, and consistency are extremely important to our team.



If you love anime and have the skills to make animation look incredible, we'd love to hear from you!



**Lamb Light Studio**  

*Stand Firm: A Light in the Shadows*

 Marketplace.

I am looking for an experienced holistic wellness, mind-body, or therapeutic practitioner who can help me explore and work on **changing limiting beliefs, transforming old emotional patterns, subconscious conditioning, and personal transformation.**



A major area of interest for me is the methodology and teachings of **Dr. Joe Dispenza**. I am interested in exploring concepts such as breaking old habits of thinking and feeling, changing subconscious patterns, meditation, visualization, emotional conditioning, and developing new mental and emotional states.



**You do NOT need to be an expert in Dr. Joe Dispenza's work or have extensive experience with his specific methodology.** Familiarity with his teachings is a plus, but what matters most is that you have a strong background in related mind-body, psychological, somatic, or experiential approaches.



I am particularly interested in someone who can help me explore different methods of working with limiting beliefs, subconscious patterns, emotions, the nervous system, and the mind-body connection.



I want to learn about different approaches, understand how they work, and, where appropriate, experience them through personalized Zoom sessions.



I am open-minded and interested in exploring multiple methodologies rather than following only one particular school of thought. I value someone who is knowledgeable, curious, experienced, and able to explain and guide different techniques.



## MODALITIES I AM PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN



You do NOT need to practice every modality below. However, I am especially interested in practitioners who have professional training or substantial experience in several of these areas.



**1. Subconscious Patterns & Belief Change**

- Limiting belief identification and transformation.

- Subconscious reprogramming approaches.

- Hypnotherapy.

- NLP (Neuro-Linguistic Programming).

- Mental rehearsal and visualization.

- Cognitive and emotional pattern change.

- Habit and behavioral reconditioning.



**2. Mind-Body & Emotional Transformation**

- Dr. Joe Dispenza-inspired meditation and mind-body approaches.

- Mind-body connection.

- Emotional processing and release.

- Somatic approaches and body-based work.

- Nervous-system regulation.

- Breathwork.

- Meditation and mindfulness.

- Guided visualization.

- Emotional conditioning and state change.



**3. Internal Patterns & Deeper Psychological Work**

- Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work.

- Inner-child work.

- Attachment-oriented approaches.

- Trauma-informed approaches.

- Emotional integration.

- Working with unconscious or deeply ingrained patterns.



**4. Other Integrative & Holistic Modalities**

- EFT / Emotional Freedom Techniques (tapping).

- Energy-oriented practices.

- Yoga-based therapeutic practices.

- Acupuncture / Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge.

- Integrative psychology.

- Other complementary or experiential approaches.



## WHAT I WANT TO LEARN AND EXPERIENCE



Part of my goal is to understand the different approaches available for changing limiting beliefs, transforming emotional patterns, and creating lasting personal change.



I want to understand:



- How do limiting beliefs develop, and how can they be changed?

- How do subconscious patterns influence our thoughts, emotions, and behavior?

- What is the relationship between the nervous system, body, and emotional states?

- How do meditation and visualization influence mental and emotional conditioning?

- How do IFS, somatic work, hypnotherapy, breathwork, and other modalities approach personal transformation differently?

- What happens during each type of session?

- Which techniques are designed to address deeper emotional patterns rather than simply discussing them?



I would like to **experience different techniques through personalized Zoom sessions**, not just learn about them theoretically.



I am interested in someone who can introduce different approaches, explain their purpose, guide appropriate exercises, and help me understand which approaches may be most useful.



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person could be:



- A Holistic Mind-Body Practitioner.

- A Subconscious Reprogramming Practitioner.

- An IFS / Parts Work Practitioner.

- A Somatic Practitioner.

- A Trauma-Informed Practitioner.

- A Hypnotherapist.

- A Breathwork Practitioner.

- A Meditation Teacher.

- An Integrative Therapist or Counselor.

- A Holistic Life Coach with substantial professional training.

- A Mind-Body Practitioner.

- Someone trained in multiple complementary approaches.



I am particularly interested in someone who has studied **multiple modalities and understands how they can complement one another.**



You should be able to distinguish between techniques you are formally trained or certified in, techniques you have practical experience with, and approaches you simply understand theoretically.



## IMPORTANT – PROFESSIONALISM & OPEN-MINDEDNESS



I value open-mindedness, curiosity, and an interest in personal transformation. However, I also value professionalism, critical thinking, and honesty.



I am not looking for someone who simply repeats spiritual concepts or makes exaggerated claims about healing or transformation.



I want someone who can explain the reasoning behind different approaches, understand their limitations, and work within their professional qualifications and scope of practice.



If you are not a licensed therapist, psychologist, physician, or other licensed healthcare professional, that is okay. Please clearly state your qualifications and professional scope.



## ZOOM SESSIONS



Sessions will primarily take place remotely through Zoom.



You should be comfortable:



- Teaching and explaining different mind-body and subconscious approaches.

- Guiding meditation, visualization, breathwork, and other appropriate exercises.

- Helping identify and explore limiting beliefs and recurring emotional patterns.

- Guiding appropriate experiential techniques.

- Providing personalized practices between sessions.

- Discussing observations and experiences after exercises.

- Explaining different approaches and recommending what may be worth exploring further.



I am looking for an individualized experience, not a generic coaching program or a series of ordinary talk-therapy sessions.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer the following questions in detail:



1. What is your professional background, education, training, licenses, and certifications?



2. Which modalities are you professionally trained or certified in?



3. What experience do you have helping people identify and work with limiting beliefs, subconscious patterns, and deeply ingrained emotional conditioning?



4. Do you have experience with IFS/Parts Work, somatic work, inner-child work, nervous-system regulation, hypnotherapy, EFT tapping, breathwork, or meditation? Please explain.



5. Are you familiar with Dr. Joe Dispenza's work, particularly his teachings on breaking old patterns, changing subconscious programs, meditation, visualization, and emotional conditioning? What is your perspective on his approach?



6. Have you personally studied or practiced any of Dr. Joe Dispenza's meditations or related mind-body techniques? If so, which ones?



7. What other approaches or practitioners have influenced your understanding of subconscious patterns, belief change, and personal transformation?



8. How do you understand the relationship between thoughts, emotions, the subconscious, nervous system, and physical body?



9. If we began working together, how would you structure our first three Zoom sessions?



10. Which techniques can you personally guide through Zoom?



11. Please provide your hourly or session rate and the normal length of your sessions.



**YOUR RATE MUST BE INCLUDED.**



## HOW TO APPLY



**Primary application:** Apply through OnlineJobs.ph.



**Alternative:** You may also contact me directly through WhatsApp:



**
**



If contacting me through WhatsApp, please introduce yourself, briefly explain your professional background, describe the modalities you specialize in, and include your hourly/session rate.



I am especially interested in finding someone who has explored multiple approaches to **limiting beliefs, subconscious transformation, emotional conditioning, and the mind-body connection** and can help me explore this field in a professional, grounded, individualized, and experiential way.

title: GTA 6 Recorder
description:
Hi! I run a GTA YouTube channel and I need someone to play GTA 6 starting on release day (November 19) and record their gameplay for me.



Yes, I will literally pay you to play GTA 6.



No commentary. No microphone. No facecam. No editing. Just clean, raw gameplay recorded in high quality that I will use in my YouTube videos.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Play GTA 6 from launch day onward

- Record your gameplay at 1440p (2K) or higher, 60fps preferred but I understand GTA 6 is in 30fps right now. 

- Record game audio only (no mic, no music, no 
, no background noise)

- Upload the raw, unedited files to a shared Google Drive

- Follow a simple list of things I want captured (story missions, driving around the map, specific locations, gameplay features, etc.)



REQUIREMENTS

- You own a PS5 or Xbox Series X (GTA 6 is console only at launch, no PC version)

- You will have GTA 6 on release day (pre-ordered or buying on launch)

- You can record at 1440p or 4K. A capture card (Elgato or similar) is preferred. PS5 built-in 4K recording is also okay.

- HDR turned OFF while recording (HDR footage looks washed out in editing)

- Notifications turned off so no pop-ups show up in the footage

- Stable internet with good UPLOAD speed (1 hour of 1440p footage can be 15 to 40 GB)

- Reliable, good communication, and you can start right away



IMPORTANT

- All footage you record for me belongs to me. Please do not post it anywhere yourself.

- I am paying for usable gameplay. Loading screens, idle time, pause menus and AFK footage do not count toward paid hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include all of the following in your application:

1. Start your application with the words "VICE CITY" so I know you read this post

2. Your rate per hour of finished footage (in USD)

3. Your console (PS5 or Xbox Series S/X) and how you record (capture card model or built-in recording)

4. A 30-second test recording. Since GTA 6 is not out yet, record ANY game (GTA 5 is a good option) using the exact same setup you will use for GTA 6. Upload it to Google Drive and share the link.Please send the original file via google drive, not a YouTube upload, so I can check the real quality.

6. How many hours per week you can play in the first 2 weeks after launch



Applications without a test clip will not be considered.



Looking forward to seeing your test footage!



Kindly,

Murray
salary: $3 per hour or $6 per hour of recording.

title: Global People Assistant
description:
*KINDLY READ THE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY BEFORE YOU APPLY.



EJF Real Estate is a well-established, Property Management company based in the District of Columbia. We are looking for Global People Assistant who are responsible, organized, detail oriented, and reliable to join our fun/hard working team. You must have excellent communication skills.



Position Summary:



The Global HR Assistant supports the day-to-day administration and coordination of Global HR operations, with a primary focus on independent contractor onboarding and offboarding, recruitment coordination, contractor records, timekeeping, privileges and offerings administration, engagement, performance tracking, and Global HR compliance. 



This role works closely with the Global HR team, department heads, and cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are completed accurately, consistently, and on time. The Global HR Assistant also serves as a primary point of contact for routine contractor inquiries while escalating complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate HR leader. 



Key Responsibilities:



1. Onboarding and Offboarding:



- Coordinate the end-to-end onboarding process for new independent contractors, including requirements, documentation, orientation, and system access. 

- Coordinate with IT, Accounting, Operations, hiring managers, and other departments to ensure new contractors are properly set up before their start date. 

- Conduct or assist with new contractor orientation and communicate applicable company guidelines, expectations, and HR processes. 

- Coordinate training schedules and initial responsibilities with managers and new contractors. 

- Facilitate contractor offboarding and coordinate with relevant departments to ensure the timely completion of access removal, documentation, final requirements, and other offboarding activities. 



2. Recruitment and Workforce Coordination:

title: ANYONE USING AI IS DISQUALIFIED – Ecommerce Bookkeeper – Shopify Fashion Dropshipping
description:
IMPORTANT: Applications written using AI will be disqualified. A voice recording is required to apply.



About Us



We run multiple Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, mainly selling to customers in the USA.



We are looking for an experienced E-commerce Bookkeeper to join our team for a long-term position.



Your main responsibility is to track and organize all financial information across our stores so we always know exactly how much money each store is making, spending, and keeping as profit.



We need someone who understands e-commerce finances, especially Shopify, Google Ads, supplier payments, and Profit & Loss (P&L) reports.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant or data entry position. You must already have experience with e-commerce bookkeeping.



Your Main Responsibilities



1. Track All Business Expenses



Record all expenses accurately and keep everything organized.



Make sure no expenses are missing or recorded twice.



Categorize expenses correctly for each store.



2. Track Advertising Expenses



Record daily advertising spend from different Google Ads and other advertising accounts.



Make sure advertising expenses are assigned to the correct Shopify store.



Keep advertising costs updated in each store's P&L sheet.



3. Track Supplier Costs



Record product costs (COGS) from multiple suppliers.



Make sure supplier payments and product costs are recorded under the correct stores.



Check supplier invoices and payment records for accuracy.



4. Manage Profit & Loss (P&L) Reports



Create and maintain separate P&L sheets for multiple Shopify stores.



Track revenue, advertising spend, product costs, payment fees, refunds, chargebacks, and other expenses.



Keep all financial information accurate and updated.



Make sure we can clearly see how much profit or loss each store is making.



5. Check and Analyze Financial Data



Regularly check the numbers to make sure everything matches.



Identify missing expenses, incorrect figures, or unusual costs.



Inform us when you notice something important.



Provide simple financial updates so we understand how each store is performing.



Requirements



Previous experience in E-commerce Bookkeeping is REQUIRED.



Experience working with Shopify stores.



Understands how dropshipping businesses operate.



Experience tracking advertising costs, supplier expenses, and store profitability.



Able to manage bookkeeping for multiple stores, advertising accounts, and suppliers at the same time.



Strong experience with Google Sheets or Excel, including creating and managing P&L reports.



Very organized, accurate, and detail-oriented.



Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Good written and spoken English.



Able to communicate clearly when there are financial issues or important updates.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who takes their work seriously and understands the importance of accurate bookkeeping.



You should be:



Proactive: You notice problems and inform us without waiting to be asked.



Detail-oriented: You double-check numbers and make sure everything is accurate.



Organized: You can manage several stores without mixing up their financial information.



Reliable: You complete your work consistently and keep reports updated.



Long-term focused: You want to grow with our business as we expand into more stores.



We value someone who does more than simply enter numbers. We want a bookkeeper who understands what the financial data means and can help us identify issues or opportunities to improve profitability.



How to Apply



IMPORTANT: Do not use AI to write your application. Applications written using AI will be disqualified.



A voice recording is MANDATORY. Applications without one will not be considered.



Please send a short voice recording answering the following questions in your own words. Use real examples from your previous work if applicable



1. E-commerce Experience



Have you worked as a bookkeeper for an e-commerce or Shopify business before? Explain what type of business it was, how many stores you handled, and what your daily responsibilities were.



2. Managing Multiple Stores



Are you experienced in managing P&L reports for multiple Shopify stores, with different advertising accounts and suppliers? Explain how you would organize and track everything to make sure each store's numbers are accurate.





Voice Recording: Upload your recording to Google Drive, Dropbox, or a similar platform, and include the link in your application. Make sure the link is accessible.



Required Application Subject Line



Shopify P/L Bookkeeper



We are looking for someone experienced, responsible, and interested in building a long-term working relationship with our growing business.

title: Real Estate Video Editor | Small Teams Welcome
description:
ZABE Media is a growing real estate media company based in Austin, Texas. We're seeking an experienced video editor or small editing team for a long-term partnership.



We prioritize exceptional video quality, consistency, reliable turnaround, and professional communication. Small teams with a dedicated primary editor and backup coverage are preferred.



THE OPPORTUNITY

- Recurring projects with flexible, per-video compensation.

- Videos include property walkthroughs, listing videos, social reels, drone videos, and agent-led content.

- Footage is primarily captured on iPhones, with additional drone and camera footage.

- Opportunities for increased production volume as we grow.



TARGET PRICING (USD)

- Property Walkthrough: $25

- Standard Listing (13 clips, 30 sec): $35

- Premium Listing (18 clips, 45 sec, drone/agent): $50

- Standard Extended (30 clips, 60 sec, drone): $50

- Premium Extended (40 clips, 90 sec, drone/agent): $75

- Drone Only (13 clips, 30 sec): $35



Prices include commercially licensed music, reasonable revisions, and final MP4 export. Rates are negotiable based on quality and reliability. Custom cinematic projects may be quoted separately.



EDITING REQUIREMENTS

- Smooth speed ramping, transitions, natural pacing, and strong shot selection.

- Professional color correction, stabilization, music synchronization, and audio balancing.

- Clean integration of interior, exterior, drone, and agent-led footage.

- Ability to edit horizontal and vertical videos.

- Internal QC to ensure consistent, client-ready results with minimal revisions.

- AI-assisted tools are welcome, but all videos require human review.



TURNAROUND & RELIABILITY

- Meet agreed deadlines based on project complexity.

- Provide prompt revisions during morning QC when needed.

- Accommodate fluctuating workloads and communicate potential delays.



TEAM EXPECTATIONS

Small teams are preferred, but individuals are welcome. Teams must have a designated primary editor and trained backup who meet the same quality standards. No reassignment without approval.



QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of professional video editing experience preferred.

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software.

- Experience with real estate walkthroughs, reels, drone, and agent-led videos.

- Reliable equipment, communication, and production capacity.

- U.S. real estate media experience is a plus.



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide:

1. Portfolio of walkthroughs, listing videos, reels, and drone edits.

2. Experience and editing software used.

3. Proposed pricing by video type and any additional fees.

4. Typical turnaround and daily/weekly capacity.

5. Individual or team structure, including backup arrangements.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid editing assessment using ZABE Media's footage. Finalists may participate in a paid production trial.



We're looking for a dependable editing partner who delivers exceptional results and can grow with ZABE Media.

Local Marketing Audit is a U.S.-based marketing agency working across strategy, design, performance marketing and ecommerce. We are growing fast and need a reliable Virtual Assistant to support our Operations Manager with recruitment, admin and day-to-day coordination.



This is a hands-on role for someone organized, quick to respond and comfortable switching between different kinds of tasks in the same day.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Recruitment support

- Write and publish job posts on Upwork and other hiring platforms

- Review incoming applications against the role requirements

- Shortlist candidates and keep clear assessment notes for each one

- Message candidates to clarify details and book interviews

- Conduct initial interviews (30 to 45 minutes)

- Prepare and forward a final shortlist with your reasoning for final interviews

- Keep the candidate tracker up to date at every stage

- Help with onboarding once a hire is confirmed



2. Administrative support

- Manage calendars, schedule meetings and send reminders

- Draft
s, follow-ups and internal updates

- Take meeting notes and turn them into clear action items

- Follow up with team members so deadlines are met

- Prepare simple reports and weekly summaries



3. Task creation and management

- Break projects down into clear tasks with owners and due dates

- Track progress and flag delays early

- Keep the task board clean, current and easy to read



4. Presentations and documents

- Build clean, professional presentations in Canva, Google Slides or PowerPoint

- Format proposals, reports, SOPs and internal documents

- Follow our brand guidelines on everything you produce



5. File and data management

- Organize Google Drive folders with clear naming and structure

- Maintain spreadsheets, trackers and records accurately

- Handle data entry and clean-up, and keep information easy to find



6. On-demand tasks

- Take on ad hoc requests as they come up: online research, quick edits, data lookups, small content tasks

- Respond quickly and deliver without needing constant follow-up





REQUIREMENTS



- 1+ years of experience as a virtual assistant, admin assistant or HR/recruitment assistant

- Strong written English: clear, correct and professional

- Experience screening candidates or supporting a hiring process

- Confident with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Calendar, Gmail)

- Good presentation design sense

- Experience with a task management tool (ClickUp, Trello, Asana, Notion or similar)

- Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

- Comfortable speaking on video calls and leading interviews

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Able to handle confidential candidate and company information with discretion

- Available full-time, with some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours





NICE TO HAVE



- Copywriting skills (job posts, social captions,
s, short marketing copy)

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in daily work

- Canva skills beyond presentations

- Experience hiring on Upwork

- Background in a marketing agency or ecommerce business





HOW TO APPLY



Start your proposal with the phrase "LMA READY" so we know you read the full post. Then include:



1. A short summary of your VA, admin and recruitment experience

2. The tools you use every day

3. One presentation or document you made (link)

4. A short writing sample, or a job post you have written

5. Your time zone, weekly availability and earliest start date

6. Your expected monthly rate in USD

7. Your portfolio and CV



Applications missing these details will not be reviewed.





OUR HIRING PROCESS



Application review, then a short initial interview, then a final interview, then a small paid test task for the strongest candidates.

title: US Senior Tax Associate
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

*Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

*Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.

title: AI Song Ad Creator (Sume / Higgsfield) – 3 Full-Length Music Video Ads Every 2–3 Days
description:
PLEASE READ THIS WHOLE POST. Somewhere below is an instruction on how to start your application. If you don't follow it, your application will be deleted without being read.



ABOUT US

We're a UK supplement brand running
 and Instagram ads every day. We want full-length song ads: an AI-made song about the product, set to a fun or emotional AI music video, that people remember and sing back.



YOU DON'T HAVE TO BE THE BEST YET

We're willing to train the right person. If you're new to AI song ads but you learn fast and care about quality, we'll give you the tools and training to learn them over your first 3–4 days. You'll be paid $150 for that training week. If we don't see clear improvement by the end of the training, the role will be ended. If you do well, your regular pay starts from that day.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Deliver a batch of 3 finished song ads every 2–3 days (each song ad roughly 3–8 minutes long), Monday to Friday

- Write catchy lyrics from our briefs (we'll give you the message, the customer and the key lines)

- Generate the song with AI music tools (Sume audio, Suno or similar): vocals, beat and a hook that sticks

- Build the music video in Sume and/or Higgsfield: AI characters, scenes, lipsync to the vocals, product shots and on-screen lyrics

- Make different styles when asked: pop, country, rap, musical theatre, old-school jingle, emotional ballad, claymation or Pixar-style animation

- Follow our scripts and notes exactly, and deliver every batch on time



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience with AI songs, AI video or video editing (send real links if you have them; it's a big plus, but not required)

- A good ear: the chorus has to be catchy, on beat, and say the product name clearly

- Willingness to learn Sume and Higgsfield quickly (we'll provide the tools)

- Able to keep up a steady pace of 3 full-length song ads every 2–3 days once trained, without the quality dropping

- Good English, and comfortable writing lyrics for a British audience (British phrases and pronunciation)

- Strong, reliable internet, and available on Slack/WhatsApp during UK working hours



OUR QUALITY STANDARDS (these are not optional)

- The hook lands in the first 2 seconds: the first line of the song has to stop the scroll

- Lipsync must match the vocals exactly, with no drifting mouths

- Realism first on any human characters: no inhuman movement, no extra fingers, hands or limbs. Check every clip twice before sending

- A character must be the exact same person in every clip of a video: same face, same hair length and colour

- Lyrics on screen must match the words being sung, spelled correctly

- Cut each shot on the beat or the moment the line ends, with no frozen hold before the cut

- The product must be sharp and clear the first time it appears on screen

- Never show other brands' packaging or logos (use plain unbranded bottles instead)

- Never copy a real song, melody or artist's voice. Everything must be original



PAY

- Training week (if needed): $150

- After training: $500/month, paid every 2 weeks ($250 per payment). Your first 2-week pay period starts the day you pass training

- Rises up to $1,000/month ($500 every 2 weeks) for consistently high-quality work delivered on time



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "Two Softgels" in the very first line. Applications that don't start with these words will not be read.

2. Send any links to songs, AI videos or edits you've made (if you have them).

3. Tell us which tools you've used before for music and video, if any.

4. Tell us in one or two sentences why you'd learn this fast.

5. Tell us your timezone and your working hours.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid test song ad before hiring.

title: Healthcare Referral Outreach Virtual Assistant
description:
Company: Harbor Home Care

Work Arrangement: Remote

Schedule: Part-time, 3 hours per day

Working Hours: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Houston, Texas time (Central Time)



About the Position



Harbor Home Care is looking for an experienced and reliable Virtual Assistant with a background in U.S. home care or home health care. The primary responsibility of this role is to make outbound calls to healthcare facilities and potential referral sources to introduce our services, build professional relationships, and generate client referrals.



We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, a pleasant, professional phone voice, and a strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare industry, particularly home care and home health care in Texas.



Key Responsibilities



- Make outbound calls to hospitals, rehabilitation centers, assisted living facilities, nursing homes, and other potential referral sources.

- Introduce Harbor Home Care and explain our home care services.

- Connect with case managers, discharge planners, social workers, referral coordinators, and other decision-makers.

- Build and maintain professional relationships with healthcare facilities and referral partners.

- Follow up with potential referral sources as needed.

- Maintain accurate records of calls, contacts, follow-ups, and outreach results.

- Provide regular updates on outreach activities and progress.



Note: This position is primarily focused on outbound calling and referral outreach. It does not involve general administrative tasks or direct patient care.



Qualifications and Requirements



- Previous experience in U.S. home care or home health care is required.

- Good understanding of the U.S. healthcare system, particularly home care and home health care in Texas.

- Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and patient confidentiality.

- Basic understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, managed care plans, and health insurance.

- Experience communicating with healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, or referral coordinators is a strong advantage.

- Native-level or near-native English communication skills.

- Clear, pleasant, confident, and professional phone voice.

- Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

- Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and speaking with healthcare professionals.

- Self-motivated, organized, reliable, and results-oriented.

- Must have a stable internet connection and a quiet working environment.



Compensation



Starting at $5 USD per hour, with opportunities for a rate increase based on performance, experience, and results.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and include details about your previous experience in U.S. home care or home health care. Highlight any experience with healthcare referral outreach, facility calling, HIPAA, and insurance-related processes.



Important: Applicants without previous U.S. healthcare, home care, or home health care experience will not be considered.

title: Amazon FBA Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



AEX Direct is a newly established U.S.-based Amazon FBA wholesale business focused on building direct relationships with brands and manufacturers.



We're starting essentially from scratch. We have the business infrastructure established and capital available to invest, but no existing sales, supplier relationships, or employees.



We're looking for an experienced Amazon wholesale professional who can build, manage, and scale a profitable six-figure or larger seller account from the ground up.



This person will be responsible for essentially all day-to-day operations, including developing the business strategy, establishing suppliers, managing inventory, hiring employees, and overseeing profitability.



The owner will provide capital, approve major financial decisions, and oversee the company's overall direction. You'll be responsible for executing the strategy and eventually running the operation with minimal day-to-day involvement from ownership.



Key Responsibilities



Build and manage an Amazon FBA brand-direct wholesale business from scratch.



Identify profitable products and establish relationships with brands, manufacturers, and authorized distributors.



Manage brand outreach, supplier negotiations, wholesale applications, and purchasing recommendations.



Analyze products using Keepa, SmartScout, AZInsight, and Seller Central.



Oversee inventory purchasing, replenishment, pricing, logistics, and Amazon account operations.



Take responsibility for operational profitability, including margins, expenses, ROI, inventory turnover, and cash flow management.



Hire, train, and manage VAs and other employees as the business grows.



Develop SOPs, reporting systems, and efficient operational processes.



Implement AI and automation tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Make, and Zapier, where beneficial.



Provide regular financial and operational reports, including sales, expenses, inventory performance, and actual profits.



Identify problems, improve efficiency, and develop strategies for sustainable growth.



Requirements



At least 3 years of hands-on Amazon FBA wholesale experience, preferably brand-direct.



Proven experience managing profitable Amazon wholesale operations.



Experience establishing brand-direct supplier relationships.



Strong knowledge of Keepa, SmartScout, AZInsight, and Amazon Seller Central.



Strong understanding of profitability, inventory management, purchasing, and cash flow.



Experience managing VAs or remote teams.



Ability to work independently, make sound business decisions, and take ownership of results.



Strong written English and communication skills.



Experience with AI tools, automation, and operational systems is preferred.



What We're Looking For



We need someone who understands the entire Amazon wholesale business, not just product sourcing.



Our priority is actual net profit, not simply generating revenue. We want someone who can protect our capital, maintain healthy margins, manage expenses, and build a sustainable operation.



Ideally, you've already helped build or manage a successful six-figure or seven-figure Amazon wholesale business and understand how to take one from zero sales to consistent profitability.



This is a long-term leadership opportunity with significant operational responsibility and independence.



Compensation is negotiable based on experience, with potential performance-based bonuses tied to verified profitability.



How to Apply



Please include:



Your Amazon wholesale management experience.



Examples of seller accounts you've managed, including approximate revenue and profitability.



Your experience establishing brand-direct supplier relationships.



Whether you've built an Amazon wholesale business from scratch.



How you would approach the first 90 days of building our business.



Your expected monthly salary and availability.

title: AI Drama Ad Creator (Sume / Higgsfield) – 3 Mini-Drama Video Ads Every 2–3 Days
description:
PLEASE READ THIS WHOLE POST. Somewhere below is an instruction on how to start your application. If you don't follow it, your application will be deleted without being read.



ABOUT US

We're a UK supplement brand running
 and Instagram ads every day. We make AI "mini-drama" ads: short cinematic stories with real characters, emotional twists and dialogue, where the product becomes part of the story. Think of a short TV drama scene that people can't stop watching.



YOU DON'T HAVE TO BE THE BEST YET

We're willing to train the right person. If you're new to AI drama ads but you learn fast and care about quality, we'll give you the tools and training to learn them over your first 3–4 days. You'll be paid $150 for that training week. If we don't see clear improvement by the end of the training, the role will be ended. If you do well, your regular pay starts from that day.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Deliver a batch of 3 finished drama ads every 2–3 days (each ad roughly 5–10 minutes long), Monday to Friday

- Turn our scene-by-scene scripts into finished videos (we write the script, characters and dialogue)

- Create the characters, locations and scenes in Sume and/or Higgsfield

- Lipsync every line of dialogue, with natural voices, British accents and real emotion (anger, tears, relief)

- Edit it all together with pacing, cuts, music, sound effects and captions, so it plays like a real TV drama

- Follow our scripts and notes exactly, and deliver every batch on time



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience with AI video, AI films or video editing (send real links if you have them; it's a big plus, but not required)

- A storyteller's eye: you know how to build tension, land a twist and make a scene feel emotional

- Willingness to learn Sume and Higgsfield quickly (we'll provide the tools)

- Able to keep up a steady pace of 3 drama ads every 2–3 days once trained, without the quality dropping

- Good English, and comfortable with British settings, accents and phrases

- Strong, reliable internet, and available on Slack/WhatsApp during UK working hours



OUR QUALITY STANDARDS (these are not optional)

- The first 3 seconds must hook: open on conflict, shock or emotion, never a slow intro

- Every character must be the exact same person in every scene: same face, same hair length and colour, same clothes unless the script changes them

- Sets must stay consistent: the same kitchen looks like the same kitchen every time we go back to it

- Realism first: no inhuman movement, no extra fingers, hands or limbs. Check every clip twice before sending

- Lipsync must match the dialogue exactly, with no drifting mouths, and every line must sound like the character's own voice

- Cut each shot the moment the line ends, with no frozen hold before the cut, and no dead pauses between lines

- No steering wheels visible in any car scene

- The product must be sharp and clear the first time it appears on screen

- Never show other brands' packaging or logos (use plain unbranded bottles instead)

- Never copy real TV shows, films or real people. Every character and story must be original



PAY

- Training week (if needed): $150

- After training: $500/month, paid every 2 weeks ($250 per payment). Your first 2-week pay period starts the day you pass training

- Rises up to $1,000/month ($500 every 2 weeks) for consistently high-quality work delivered on time



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "The Other Half" in the very first line. Applications that don't start with these words will not be read.

2. Send any links to AI videos, short films or edits you've made (if you have them).

3. Tell us which tools you've used before for AI video and editing, if any.

4. Tell us in one or two sentences why you'd learn this fast.

5. Tell us your timezone and your working hours.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid test scene before hiring.

title: Real Estate Media VA (Photoshop + Social Media)
description:
Do you notice the trash can in the corner of a photo before you notice the kitchen? Are you detail-oriented, creative, and great at keeping things clean and polished? If so, we'd love to have you join our team!



About Us:

Listing Edge Media is a husband-and-wife real estate media company serving agents with listing photos, walkthrough videos, virtual twilights and virtual staging. We believe in honest, high-quality work and supporting each other along the way. We're looking for a detail-oriented, creative Virtual Assistant to own the step between "shoot finished" and "photos delivered," and to help grow our brand through social media posting and Instagram outreach.



What You'll Be Doing:



* Pick the Best Photos: Review each processed shoot in AutoHDR and select the strongest shots to match the photo count the client ordered.

* Clean Them Up: Download the selected photos and use Photoshop's Remove tool to take out temporary distractions like trash cans, cords, hoses, personal items, and our own shadows or reflections.

* Quality Control: Check every photo against our Remove vs. Leave checklist before delivery, and flag anything you're unsure about.

* Prepare for Delivery: Rename files to our standard format, upload them to HDPhotoHub, and get the order ready to deliver.

* Social Media Posting: Create carousels, Reels from our walkthrough videos, and before-and-after cleanups. Get creative beyond our photos with tips for agents and sellers, behind-the-scenes clips, Canva graphics, and trending Reel formats. Write captions in our voice (short, helpful, no hype) with local hashtags. Reply to comments and pass client questions to us.

* Instagram Outreach: Find and follow real estate agents in our service areas, engage genuinely with their posts first, then send 10 personalized DMs per day using our scripts (no copy-paste spam). Log every conversation in our tracker and hand interested agents to us.



Photo delivery comes first each shift; posting and outreach fill the rest of your time.



What We're Looking For:



* Photoshop Experience: Comfortable with the Remove and Generative tools. Real estate photo experience is a big plus.

* An Eye for the Best Shot: You can pick the strongest of several similar photos and build a set that tells the story of the home.

* Honesty Over Perfection: We never edit out permanent features like cracks, damage or fixtures. When in doubt, you ask.

* Great Written and Spoken English: For captions and team communication. Client communication may be added as the role grows.

* Fast, Reliable Internet (Required): You'll download and upload full photo sets every day.

* Instagram-Savvy and Quick to Learn: Comfortable with Instagram for business; Canva is a plus. We'll train you on AutoHDR and HDPhotoHub.

* Willingness to Work U.S. Eastern Time (5:00-8:00 p.m. ET, Monday-Friday): That's about 6:00-9:00 a.m. Philippine time (5:00-8:00 a.m. during U.S. daylight saving time).



Schedule & Pay:



* 3 hours per day, Monday-Friday

* $5/hour to start, paid weekly, with raises based on performance

* Long-term role



Why You'll Love Working with Us:



* Supportive Team: Your work gets noticed, and we'll make sure you have everything you need to succeed.

* Clear Checklists: Templates and a Remove vs. Leave guide, so you always know what's expected.

* Room to Grow: More hours and responsibility as we expand into new markets.



If you are interested:



Send your resume, a screenshot of an internet speed test, and a 1-2 minute video introducing yourself to 
 with the subject line "Clean Shot" (applications without it will be skipped). Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test edit, and we will reach out with next steps!

title: Remote Analytical Data Reviewer – LC-MS Peptide Testing
description:
About the role

We are a peptide testing laboratory looking for a detail-oriented chemist to review LC-MS data remotely. You will review research-use-only (RUO) peptide data generated on a Shimadzu LCMS-2020 single quadrupole mass spectrometer with LabSolutions software, through secure VPN access.



This is a data-review role, not a bench role. You will confirm molecular weights, verify UV and TIC peak-area purity calculations, profile synthetic impurities, and produce audit-ready review records that support Certificates of Analysis (COAs) and client reports.



What you will do

- Perform primary review of LC-MS data to confirm the molecular weight of target peptides (multiply charged ions, adducts and deconvolution where applicable).

- Execute and verify UV and TIC peak-area integration in LabSolutions for purity calculations, following established methods and acceptance criteria.

- Profile and document synthetic impurities (deletions, truncations, oxidations, adducts and related substances) by retention time and mass.

- Apply method-specific acceptance criteria, such as MW match within single-quadrupole tolerance (typically ±0.5 Da), purity thresholds and impurity reporting rules.

- Identify and escalate integration issues, co-elutions, baseline problems and spectral anomalies with clear documentation.

- Generate accurate review records, reports and COA-supporting data packages.

- Answer technical questions from customers.

- Assist with method development and method changes.

- Maintain strict data integrity and follow SOPs for remote review, version control and electronic records.

- Handle high-throughput volume with consistent turnaround while meeting quality standards.

- Take part in method training, periodic competency assessments and process improvement.



Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related field. Licensed Chemists (RCh) are welcome to apply.

- At least 2–3 years of hands-on experience reviewing HPLC or LC-MS data, preferably peptide or small-molecule pharmaceutical or research samples.

- Proven ability to perform accurate peak integration, purity calculations and impurity evaluation from chromatographic and mass spectral data.

- Experience with single-quadrupole LC-MS systems and data processing software. LabSolutions experience is a strong advantage; training is provided.

- Solid understanding of peptide analysis, including multiply charged ions and common synthetic impurities.

- Excellent attention to detail, consistency and documentation habits.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection or power source, a quiet home workspace, and the ability to work independently.

- Strong written English for clear, precise scientific documentation.



Preferred qualifications

- PhD in Chemistry (strongly preferred).

- Direct experience with Shimadzu LabSolutions and/or the LCMS-2020 or similar single-quad systems.

- Background in peptide synthesis impurity profiling or RUO/COA testing.

- Experience in high-throughput or contract laboratory (CRO/QC) data review.

- Familiarity with data integrity (ALCOA+) and electronic records practices.

- Prior remote analytical review work.



Tools and training

- Secure remote access to LabSolutions via VPN.

- Training and SOPs for our peptide methods, acceptance criteria and review workflow.

- Standard productivity tools for reporting and communication.



Pay and terms

- USD 2,500 per month for full-time equivalent hours (approx. 40–50 hrs/week), depending on experience and performance.

- Throughput and accuracy bonuses available after probation.

- Paid weekly or bi-weekly by international transfer (Wise, bank transfer or equivalent).

- 90-day probation with competency checks and dual-review sampling before you are authorized for independent primary review.

- Flexible hours within defined service windows. High reliability is required.

- Long-term engagement with more volume as the testing business grows.



How to apply

Apply through this posting and include the following:

1. Your resume or CV, highlighting LC-MS or HPLC data review experience.

2. A brief summary of any peptide or single-quadrupole work.

3. One or two paragraphs on how you approach peak integration consistency and impurity evaluation.

4. Your available weekly hours and preferred start date.

5. Your current location and time zone.



Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: Healthcare Growth & Partnerships
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month



ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results. You will need to do outreach calls to local offices to help Ravora build partnerships and referral channels in which you will own as part of the business development role.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



RAVORA GROWTH



Then include the following:



1. INTRODUCTION



Tell us briefly about your background and why this position interests you.



2. RESUME



Please include your current resume or CV.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Please provide a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself.



A major part of this role involves professional communication with U.S. healthcare offices, so spoken English is important.



4. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us about any experience you have with:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Healthcare

* Marketing

* Client outreach

* Google Ads

* CRM systems

* Project coordination



5. PROJECT OWNERSHIP



Tell us about one project where you were given a goal but not detailed step-by-step instructions.



What was the goal?



What did you do?



What was the result?



6. SHORT CASE STUDY



Imagine Ravora Health asks you:



"We want to build relationships with local therapy practices and primary care offices that could refer psychiatric patients to us."



Briefly explain how you would begin this project.



We are especially interested in how you would:



* Find potential partners

* D
 which organizations to prioritize

* Contact them

* Track your outreach

* Follow up

* Measure results



7. AI TOOLS



Tell us which AI tools you currently use and give us one example of how you have used AI to complete work more efficiently.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Ravora Health and become an important member of our business development and marketing team.
