title: B2B Sales Executive & Logistics Researcher (UK Market)
description:
# B2B Sales Executive & Logistics Researcher – UK Market



**Company:** AKNB Logistics  

**Location:** Remote (Philippines)  

**Employment:** Full-Time, 40 Hours per Week  

**Salary:** $650/month + Performance Bonuses  

**Working Hours:** UK Business Hours (Evening/Night Shift in the Philippines)



### About AKNB Logistics



AKNB Logistics is a growing UK-based logistics company providing same-day, urgent and scheduled courier services to businesses across London and surrounding areas.



We are looking for an ambitious, highly organised and experienced B2B sales professional to help build our courier network and acquire long-term business customers.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow alongside a developing company.



### Phase 1: Courier Network Development



Your initial responsibility will be to research and develop our network of independent courier subcontractors.



Responsibilities include:



- Research and contact independent courier drivers and transport operators across London.

- Identify vehicle types, including small vans, Transit vans and Luton vans.

- Collect trade rates, operating locations, working hours and availability.

- Obtain relevant insurance and business information for management review.

- Negotiate competitive trade rates where appropriate.

- Maintain a well-organised database of subcontractors.

- Build professional relationships with reliable courier partners.



### Phase 2: B2B Sales & Customer Acquisition



Once the initial courier network is established, your primary responsibility will shift to generating customers for AKNB Logistics.



Responsibilities include:



- Research potential UK business customers, including manufacturers, engineering companies, wholesalers and distributors.

- Cold-call businesses and speak directly with decision-makers.

- Confidently explain our courier services and value proposition.

- Identify businesses requiring urgent, same-day or scheduled deliveries.

- Handle objections and build relationships with prospective customers.

- Follow up through telephone calls and professional
s.

- Generate qualified leads, quotation opportunities and new paying customers.

- Maintain accurate CRM records and report sales activity.

- Work towards agreed daily and monthly sales targets.



### Requirements



**Essential:**

- Minimum 1 year of proven B2B cold-calling or outbound sales experience.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident telephone communication and objection-handling skills.

- Proven ability to speak with business owners and decision-makers.

- Strong online research and data management skills.

- Experience working with Excel, Google Sheets or CRM software.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet working environment.

- Willingness to work UK business hours.



**Highly Desirable:**

- Previous experience calling UK businesses.

- Logistics, transport, courier or freight sales experience.

- Experience generating customers rather than only booking appointments.

- Familiarity with lead generation and sales prospecting tools.



### Compensation & Growth



- Competitive monthly base salary.

- Performance-based bonuses for acquiring profitable paying customers.

- Long-term employment opportunity.

- Opportunity to progress into a senior sales or business development role as the company expands.

- Direct communication with the company founder.



### How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your CV and relevant sales experience.

2. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your B2B sales background.

3. Details of previous cold-calling results, including customers acquired or appointments generated.

4. Any experience selling to UK businesses.

5. Your availability to work UK business hours.



**Important:** Applications without a voice recording or relevant sales experience may not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and paid practical assessment.



We are looking for someone confident, motivated, professional and capable of delivering measurable results — not someone who simply makes calls without generating opportunities.
